title: C-D fix round: fit_result shrinks any list field; numbered code excerpts and line in the spec-review schema (review T-0053)
spec:
Why: review T-0053 on commit 41df1ae (full text: /Users/k3ntaw/code/orchestrator/.orchestrator/tasks/T-0053.json). HIGH: spawn.fit_result truncates only result["findings"]; spec_review results carry "risks" (and reviews carry "comments"), so an oversize list is never trimmed and bus.post_result raises → the fail-safe marks the task failed and the verdict is lost. MED: code_excerpts strips line numbers and the risk schema has no line, so risks cannot be anchored. (The reviewer's third comment about a test-result line referred to the review task's own acceptance, not this spec; ignore it.)

What (3 files: orchestrator/spawn.py, .orchestrator/prompts/spec-review.md, tests/test_spawn.py; this worktree branches from task/T-0049):
1. spawn.fit_result: generalize — when the result is over cap, first truncate summary to 1,500 chars, then for every list-valued top-level key (findings, risks, comments, suggested_spec_changes, open_questions, suggested_next, any other list) binary-search the longest prefix that fits, largest list first; record truncated = {"reason", "original_chars", "trimmed": {key: dropped_count}}. Keep the existing findings behaviour as a special case of this.
2. code_excerpts: prefix each excerpt line with its 1-based line number (`  12| text`) so a reviewer can cite path:line; keep the 120-line and 12,000-char caps.
3. spec-review.md: risks items gain "line": 0 and the instruction "line = the numbered line in the excerpt, 0 if none"; keep the template under 3,000 chars.
4. tests/test_spawn.py: fit_result on a result with 60 risks of 300 chars and no findings fits under bus.MAX_RESULT_CHARS with truncated.trimmed["risks"] > 0; a rendered spec-review prompt contains numbered excerpt lines (regex `^\s*\d+\| `); keep existing tests.

Run `uv run python -m unittest discover -q tests`. Commit: "spawn: fit_result trims any list field; numbered excerpts and line-anchored risks for spec review (review T-0053)" with a revert-path body.
acceptance: uv run python -m unittest discover -q tests exits 0 with the new fit_result and numbered-excerpt tests
fit_result on a risks-only oversize result returns JSON under bus.MAX_RESULT_CHARS with truncated.trimmed.risks set
spec-review prompt excerpts carry line numbers and the schema has a line field
git diff --stat limited to orchestrator/spawn.py, .orchestrator/prompts/spec-review.md, tests/test_spawn.py

result.summary:
Done. Committed as `70c0aa5` on `task/T-0055`.

**Summary:** Generalized `fit_result` to binary-search every list-valued key in an oversize result (largest first) instead of only `findings`, so `risks` (spec_review) and `comments` (review) get trimmed too — fixes the bug where an oversize risks/comments list caused `bus.post_result` to raise and the verdict to be lost. `code_excerpts` now prefixes each line with its 1-based line number; `spec-review.md`'s risk schema gained a `"line"` field (0 if none) so risks can be anchored to path:line.

**Files changed:**
- `orchestrator/spawn.py` — `fit_result` generalized to all list keys with `truncated.trimmed`; `code_excerpts` numbers lines
- `.orchestrator/prompts/spec-review.md` — risk schema gets `"line":0` + instruction, still well under 3,000 chars
- `tests/test_spawn.py` — new tests: risks-only oversize result trims under cap, spec-review prompt contains numbered excerpt lines (`^\s*\d+\| `)

**Test output:** `uv run python -m unittest discover -q tests` and `.claude/hooks/tests-green.sh` both exit 0, 69 tests, no failures.
